Class CameraIntersectionIntegration

java.lang.Object
renderer.CameraIntersectionIntegration
public class CameraIntersectionIntegration extends Object
Integration tests for camera ray construction and geometry intersections.

The tests verify that rays constructed through a 3x3 view plane intersect spheres, planes, and triangles with the expected total number of intersections.

    • assertIntersectionsCount

      private void assertIntersectionsCount(Camera camera, Intersectable geometry, int expectedCount, String message)
      Counts all intersections between rays constructed through the camera view plane and a given geometry, then compares the count with the expected value.
      Parameters:
      camera - the camera used to construct rays
      geometry - the geometry tested for intersections
      expectedCount - the expected total number of intersections
      message - the assertion failure message
